title: Law to end setback rule on Eastern Parkway Extension
summary: This bill removes the 30-foot building setback requirement along Eastern Parkway Extension in Brooklyn, from Ralph Avenue to Bushwick Avenue, except on the southern side between Ralph Avenue and Pitkin Avenue where it remains. More than 155 tax lots along the extension already have buildings that do not comply with the current setback. The law would take effect immediately and apply to existing buildings and structures.
